hypotheses.justification: This is a Prop binder that nothing else in the statement mentions, and the proof never uses it. The proof only needs: n ≠ 0, which gives finiteness of the pullback; hne₁, which makes U nonempty; he₁; the curve model Mdl₁; and the GenChartTools / AlgebraicCurve lemmas. Each of those lemmas gets its arguments explicitly (Mdl₁, c₁, e₁, he₁, morphisms, sets), and a Prop hypothesis like this one cannot be found by instance search. So the same proof works after deleting it.
